request.style: English, female soul voice, warm and resonant, solo with gospel choir, upright piano, acoustic guitar, bass, drums, organ, hopeful and triumphant, 84 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
No human being stands in sight
By works of law we find no light
Through the law we know our sin
But the revelation begins

[Chorus]
All have sinned and fall short
Of the glory of God so much
Justified freely by his grace
Through the redemption in this place
In Christ Jesus we are found
By faith alone on holy ground

[Verse]
Apart from the law it is shown
The righteousness God has known
Attested by the prophets clear
For all who believe draw near

[Chorus]
All have sinned and fall short
Of the glory of God so much
Justified freely by his grace
Through the redemption in this place
In Christ Jesus we are found
By faith alone on holy ground

[Bridge]
No distinction between the high
Nor the low beneath the sky
God presented him as the sacrifice
Received through faith in his sacrifice

[Outro]
Boasting is excluded from the view
On the principle of faith we renew
